welcome.part1: Hello and welcome to Arcky's PBS Editor!
welcome.part2: To get started, choose how you want to provide your PBS files:

option1.par: Grant file access and select your local Essentials Project folder.

option2.par: Upload the PBS file(s) you want to edit.

fileaccess.label: File access
fileaccess.info: Grant the Editor access to your chosen Project folder on your pc.

projectfolder.label: Project Folder
projectfolder.info: The path on your computer which contains the Essentials Project folder.

installedplugins.label: Installed Plugins
installedplugins.info: When file access is enabled, the editor will automatically detect the suported plugins you have installed.

language.label: Language
language.info: Set the editor to a prefered language.

autosave.label: Auto Save
autosave.info: Choose to enable or disable auto save.

notypelimit.label: No Type Limit
notypelimit.info: Choose whether to allow more than 2 types to be selected for Pokémon and Pokémon Forms.
